name: Latinx Therapy
description: Online directory of Latinx therapists and mental health resources for the Latinx community.

sections.title: About Latinx Therapy
sections.text: Latinx Therapy is a mental health resource platform created to increase accessibility to culturally competent mental health care for the Latinx community. Founded by Dr. Adriana Alejandre, the organization addresses the significant barriers Latinx individuals face in accessing mental health services, including language barriers, lack of culturally competent providers, and cultural stigma around mental health. Latinx Therapy provides a therapist directory, podcast, and educational resources designed specifically for the Latinx community.

sections.title: Finding a Latinx Therapist
sections.text: The Latinx Therapy directory helps you find mental health professionals who identify as Latinx or specialize in serving Latinx clients. Providers understand cultural factors affecting Latinx mental health including immigration experiences, family dynamics, machismo and marianismo, acculturation stress, and intergenerational trauma. Many providers offer services in Spanish or are bilingual. The directory allows you to search by location, specialty, insurance, and language to find a therapist who can provide culturally responsive care.

sections.title: Latinx Therapy Podcast
sections.text: The Latinx Therapy Podcast is a bilingual podcast that destigmatizes mental health in the Latinx community. Episodes cover topics relevant to Latinx mental health including navigating familia dynamics, immigration trauma, racial identity, dating and relationships, and specific mental health conditions. The podcast features conversations with mental health professionals and community members, making mental health information accessible in a familiar, culturally relevant format. Episodes are available in both English and Spanish.

sections.title: Culturally Relevant Resources
sections.text: Latinx Therapy provides articles, guides, and resources that address mental health through a cultural lens. Resources acknowledge the unique stressors facing Latinx communities including discrimination, immigration concerns, language barriers, and the pressure to support extended family. Educational content helps community members understand mental health conditions, recognize when to seek help, and communicate about mental health with family members who may hold different beliefs. Resources emphasize that seeking help is a sign of strength, not weakness.

sections.title: Community and Impact
sections.text: Latinx Therapy works to change how the Latinx community views and accesses mental health care. The organization partners with community groups, universities, and media outlets to spread mental health awareness and reduce stigma. By providing free accessible resources and amplifying Latinx voices in mental health, Latinx Therapy helps ensure that cultural background is not a barrier to getting help. The organization's vision is a Latinx community where mental health is prioritized and culturally competent care is accessible to all.
